en: The image appears to be a vintage black-and-white postcard showing a woman sitting on a chair, holding a baby who is being fed by a nursing goat standing on a small table. There is also a young child, unclothed, standing nearby and looking at the camera. The setting looks domestic, possibly rural or colonial, with a tiled floor and a window in the background. In the lower right corner, there is printed text.
